sections.title: Key details
sections.content: No deliverables, deadline, budget or constraints were found in the brief.

sections.title: Gaps and risks
sections.content:
- The brief names no deliverables and no audience, so the work cannot be sized.
- "Make it nice" gives no usable design direction.
- No deadline or timeline is given.
- No budget is given.
Deliverables, deadline, budget, target audience and constraints are missing; the client should confirm them.

sections.title: Questions to ask
sections.content:
- What should the website do, and which pages or features do you need?
- When do you need the website to be ready?
- What budget do you have in mind for this project?
- What does "nice" mean to you -- can you share an example of a website you like?

response_json.summary: The brief is not ready to start work. First clarify what the website needs to do.
